title: Salaam Lijiye Bhayya Watan Chali Zainab
body:
Lahad pa binte Ali ne rasheed roke kaha, salaam lijiye bhaiyya watan chali Zainab
Guzar gaya mera Abbas tum bhi rooth gaye, gazare kis tarha tanha ye zindagi Zainab
Bade sitam hue par mout hi nahi aayi, ke tujh pe rone ko duniya mein rehgayi Zainab
Na mere oun-o-mohammad hain aur na Akbar hai, talaash karti hai aankhaon ki raoushni zaianab
Ajeeb aalam-e-ghurbat tha kya kahoon bhaiyya, bhula na payegi zindaan ki teeregi Zainab, Sakina bibi ko zindaan mein khoke aayi hoon, hai sharmsaar bahut bhayi apki Zainab
Lahad pa bhayi ki faryad karti thi Zainab, sawar ki jiye bhaiyya watan chali Zainab..
